content.short: Trails is an SDK for one-click crypto payments across any chain, token or wallet.
content.description: Trails is a payments SDK that abstracts away which chain the payer holds funds on and which the recipient wants, handling routing so a checkout becomes one click. Payment flows are where chain fragmentation is felt most acutely, because a user who must bridge before paying will often simply abandon the transaction.
content.meta: Payments routed across chains and tokens so checkout stays a single click.
